meta.title: simple-tile logic timing database (3.3 V rail, 20 MHz shift clock target)
meta.rule: every cell carries its datasheet source; values not specified by the source at 3.3 V stay null and yield UNKNOWN, never invented numbers
meta.temperature_axis: industrial corner -40..+125 C where offered, else -40..+85 C (noted per device)
meta.note: the 'assumptions' block is NOT datasheet data: every system/interconnect term starts null -> dependent paths report UNKNOWN until the chassis/route is measured. Reviewer rule: datasheet-only sums are component-level NECESSARY constraints, never a 20 MHz system sign-off

clock_fwd_hop.meaning: interconnect flight time + uncertainty of the forwarded clock, one tile hop

data_hop.meaning: interconnect flight time + uncertainty of the returned data, one tile hop

latch_hop.meaning: latch line interconnect flight time + uncertainty, one tile hop

ctrl_cable_out.meaning: controller BOARD_CLK/BOARD_LATCH to first tile: cable + connector flight + skew

ctrl_cable_in.meaning: first tile B_data to controller FPGA pin: cable + connector flight + skew

fpga_sample_route.meaning: FPGA-internal BOARD_DATA sampling route/skew relative to the output clock

latch_pulse_width.meaning: actual latch-high pulse width produced by the (not yet implemented) 16-tile 20 MHz controller; the existing FSM's ~1.42 us tick at 350 kHz does NOT qualify

latch_deassert_to_first_clk.meaning: gap from latch deassertion reaching the LAST tile of the chain to the first board-clock edge there

ti_74lvc165a.notes: tpd_cq = CLK or CLK INH to QH/QHbar; tpd_load_out = SH/LD to QH (asynchronous parallel load to output, the first-bit path)

source.doc: TI SN74HC161 datasheet SCLS297D (Jan 1996, rev. Sep 2003)

ti_74hc161.conditions: datasheet specifies 2 V / 4.5 V / 6 V ONLY; NO 3.3 V column
ti_74hc161.notes: rev-A U109 as-built. 4.5 V values are reference-only and NOT valid at 3.3 V; timability of the rev-A counter at 3.3 V is UNPROVABLE from this datasheet

source.doc: TI SN74LV161A datasheet SCLS404F (Apr 1998, rev. Dec 2005)
source.tables: timing requirements VCC=3.3V+/-0.3V; switching characteristics VCC=3.3V+/-0.3V

ti_74lv161a.conditions: VCC = 3.3V +/- 0.3V, CL = 50 pF, SN74LV161A full range (TPD* marked: production-tested except for MIL-PRF-38535 variants)
ti_74lv161a.notes: count-mode CLK to RCO max = 16 ns (CL=50 pF); 23.5 ns is preset-mode RCO; proposed drop-in replacement for the 3.3 V-unprovable HC161

ti_74lvc2g08.conditions: VCC = 3.3V +/- 0.3V, CL = 50 pF (parameter measurement info table), -40..+125 C
ti_74lvc2g08.notes: rev-A U102: W = T_W AND B_first, and flag AND (B_data AND Tc)

ti_74lvc2g32.notes: rev-A U106: latch OR and flag feedback OR

ti_74lvc2g125.notes: rev-A U107: T_clk clock forward and T_data buffer (active-low OE)

ti_74lvc2g126.notes: rev-A U101: L_clk clock forward and L_data buffer (active-high OE)

ti_74lvc1g04.notes: rev-A U105 (~rst inverter); also the external ~PL inverter of the true-Z GAL variant

ti_74lvc2g74.notes: rev-A U108 sticky flag; tpd_cq_max = CLK to Q at -40..125 C (Q-bar column: 7.2 ns)

source.tables: 3. DC and AC Operating Conditions (LV10C section: VCC 3.0-5.5 V), 3.3 AC Characteristics, 3.6 Output Test Loads

atf22lv10c.conditions: LV10C section: VCC 3.0..3.6 V (DC test at 3.6 V), output test load CL = 35 pF, commercial/industrial per ordering code
atf22lv10c.notes: tcf = clock to feedback; ts covers input-or-feedback setup including the BW D input (BDATA in through the array); internal-feedback fmax = 1/(ts+tcf) rates the 4-bit counter loop

atf1502asv.conditions: VCC = 3.0..3.6 V, -15 grade, CL = 35 pF output loads
atf1502asv.notes: register AR from PT3 or GCLR, AP from PT5 (DS20006485A text; simultaneous PT3-AR + PT5-AS per macrocell also consistent with prjbureau fuzzed fusemap - see logic/cpld/results/verification)

source.doc: Lattice iCE40 UltraPlus Family Data Sheet FPGA-DS-02008-2.4 (Feb 2025)
source.tables: General I/O Pin Parameters (global buffer clock, no PLL); note 1: 'All the data is from the worst cases'

lattice_ice40up5k.conditions: PIO, global buffer clock without PLL, worst case
lattice_ice40up5k.notes: tco_pio has no MIN column: same-edge launched-data hold margin against the FPGA's 5.55 ns hold is UNPROVABLE from the datasheet (min-corner analysis needs an FPGA-out min)
